name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for foreclosed property remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for foreclosed property remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor, look for experience with foreclosed properties, local licensing, and positive client references. Verify their insurance and bonding to protect your investment. Review their portfolio for similar projects and ensure clear communication regarding project scope, timelines, and costs. A reliable contractor provides detailed contracts and demonstrates a commitment to quality and client satisfaction, offering peace of mind throughout the renovation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, local licensing, insurance, strong references, clear communication, and a detailed contract.
